english.title: Licence holder permit a person under 18 of age to enter a sex establishment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a licence for a sex establishment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE ESTABLISHMENT..), without reasonable excuse, knowingly permitted **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), a person under 18 years of age to enter it
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 23(1)(a) and (2) of Schedule 3 to the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982.
english.pointstoprove:
